The homepage publication list (wiki.mcs.anl.gov/leyffer, HTTP 503 on 2026-10-10) was read from the Wayback Machine snapshot 20250720131634 (page last edited 21 June 2025); it supplied DOIs, H items and the evidence for several dup_of links (see notes). The 224 rows' citation counts sum to 12,362 and give h-index 43 and i10-index 113, the profile's values. All 125 DOIs resolve at doi.org (302) and match their Crossref (121) or DataCite (4) titles once Scholar's appended author strings (': S. Leyffer, P. Manns' and the like) are ignored; H001's DataCite title is the file name 'Opti17.pdf' and the PDF's first page carries the H001 title. All 39 arXiv links (35 distinct ids) open on arxiv.org with Leyffer among the authors and matching titles (S137, S140 and S143 match the v1 titles; S052 and S068 through arXiv's DOI field; S123 through identical authors and abstract), and an arXiv author search lists exactly these 35 ids. All 92 DBLP records (pid 91/745, SPARQL) map to records here. A Crossref title search for the 77 non-dup rows without a DOI or arXiv id found no missing DOI. Corrected where two independent sources agree against Scholar: S004 2011->2012 (Crossref, homepage), S081 2014->2015 (DBLP, Crossref), S096 2025->2026 and S114 2025->2026 (DBLP, Crossref print date; Scholar showed the online-first year); S211's empty year filled with 2017 (homepage, DataCite).
